style.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF and pearl white #F7FAFE for packshots and spec screens, dreamy ice blue #DDE9F8 to ocean blue #2E6BD6 gradients for benefit, mechanism and CTA shots
style.iconSystem: thin-line circular badge icons and fine-line ring graphics, single ocean blue accent
style.lightingSystem: bright soft cool studio lighting, upper-left key with gentle fill, luminous halo accents, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool ocean-blue skincare visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of pearl white #F7FAFE, ice blue #DDE9F8, ocean blue accent #2E6BD6 and deep navy text #24437C; bright soft cool studio lighting with gentle gradient glow and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; minimal thin-line circular badge icon style; dreamy bubble-and-glow ocean aesthetic mixed with clean infographic elements; stable product scale with the bottle kept upright and the label fully legible; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no bubbles or glow covering the product label
style.presentationRules: the frosted gradient bottle stays upright and prominent, stable hero scale, label fully legible, bubbles and glow never cover the label
style.surfaceSystem: matte white-wood vanity counter #EDE7DE and pale ice-blue matte panel #E9F1FA
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, deep navy #24437C headlines with ocean blue #2E6BD6 accents
